video.title: UNSOLVED Bible Mysteries Explained
video.description:
Some of the Bible’s biggest mysteries still leave people asking questions. Where is Jesus’ tomb? Has Noah’s Ark ever been found? What happened to the Ark of the Covenant? And who was Cain’s wife?

In this video, we examine what the Bible says, explore historical and archaeological evidence, and separate facts from theories.

#BibleMysteries #BibleHistory #BiblicalArchaeology #JesusTomb #NoahsArk #ArkOfTheCovenant #Cain #ChristianHistory #BibleExplained #OwensBible

transcript.text: The Bible has been studied for thousands of years, but even after all this time, there are still things in the Bible that we simply don't have clear answers to.
So today we're looking at some of the biggest unsolved mysteries in the Bible.
Make sure you like, subscribe, comment and share this video so it can reach more people.
Let's start with Jesus's appearance.
What did Jesus actually look like?
We mostly know him as a light skinned man with long brown hair and a beard.
What if I told you he looked nothing like this?
You see, the Bible never describes his face, height, skin tone, or hair.
This is strange because the gospels tell us where he went, what he taught, the miracles he performed, and how he died, but never what he looked like.
Isaiah 53:2 says, he had no beauty or majesty to attract us to him, nothing in his appearance that we should desire him.
Now, this does not necessarily mean Jesus was ugly.
It means he looked really, really ordinary.
Throughout history, Jesus has been shown with short hair, long hair, light skin, dark skin.
You see, different regions around the world had their own versions of what Jesus looked like.
But as European colonialism spread around the world, the European version of Jesus became the most popular, which is what we see today.
In 2001, forensic artist Richard Neve studied ancient Jewish skulls from Jerusalem and created the face of a typical man from Jesus's time.
The result showed us a shorter man with darker skin, dark eyes, a broad face, and short curly hair.
It was not Jesus's exact face, but it may be closer to what he looked like than the images most of us know.
Every picture of Jesus is still someone's interpretation.
His real face remains unknown.
Why was the Book of Enoch banned from the Bible?
The book was written by Enoch, and it talks about mysteries that no ordinary human should have been able to know.
It describes what heaven looks like, hidden places no human had seen, angels kept in prison, and the judgment waiting for the world.
For centuries, the book was believed to be lost in many parts of the world, but in the mid-1900s, ancient pieces of it were discovered among the Dead Sea scrolls.
And if you don't know what that means, the Dead Sea Scrolls are thousands of ancient Jewish writings discovered inside caves near the Dead Sea.
They include very old copies of Bible books and other religious writings.
Pieces of the Book of Enoch were found among them, proving that Jewish people were reading it more than 2000 years ago before Jesus was even born.
One of the most disturbing stories in the book is about 200 fallen angels who came down to earth, took human wives, and gave birth to giants.
These children were known as the Nephilim.
They are the giants mentioned in the Bible.
These angels also taught forbidden knowledge, like how to make weapons, practice sorcery, and study the stars.
Violence then spread across the earth, and God sent the flood.
Enoch himself is also a mystery.
The Bible says he did not die, but was taken by God, making him one of only two people in the Bible who did not die.
However, researchers believe the Book of Enoch was written by different people over several centuries after Enoch's time.
This made religious leaders question who truly wrote it.
Now, the real mystery is not only what the Book of Enoch reveals, but why a book this ancient and influential was rejected by most of Christianity.
It did not disappear everywhere.
The Ethiopian Orthodox Church still considers its scripture and includes it in its Bible today.
What exactly was Leviathan?
The Bible describes a creature so terrifying that no human could capture or defeat it.
Job 41 says its teeth are surrounded by terror.
Its scales are tightly packed like armor.
Smoke comes from its nose, and flames come from its mouth.
Swords, spears, and arrows are almost useless against it.
And when it moves through the water, it makes the sea look like it's boiling.
But the big question is, was Leviathan a real animal?
Some people think it was a crocodile.
That would make sense because crocodiles have powerful jaws, have thick scales, and live in water.

But it gets even more interesting.
An old copy of Revelation called Papyrus 115 was found in Oxyrhynchus, Egypt.
It was written more than 1600 years ago.
In one of the piece containing Revelation 13 18, the number of the beast is written as 616 instead of 666.
Another old copy of Revelation also says 616.
Now, we know when Nero's full name is written with Hebrew letters, we get the number 666.
But when it's written without the final letter n of the first name, and it's just Nero Caesar, it adds up to 616.
Shocking, right?
Some people believe 666 is a symbol of the evil things humans do.
In the Bible, seven often represents completeness, while six falls short.
Some Christians also believe the number will identify an evil ruler who is yet to come.
So, was 666 a secret name for Nero, a symbol of human evil, or the number of a future ruler?
The Bible gives us clues, but the true meaning remains a mystery.
Where was the Garden of Eden?
We all know the Garden of Eden was the first home of Adam and Eve.
But after they disobeyed God, they were banished from the garden.
So where was this garden?
Genesis says God planted the garden in a land called Eden, and a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden.
After leaving the garden, it divided into four rivers: the Pishon, Gihon, Tigris, and Euphrates.
Two of these rivers, the Tigris and Euphrates, still exist today.
They flow through Turkey, Syria, and Iraq.
Because of this, many people believe Eden was somewhere around ancient Mesopotamia.
But the locations of the Pishon and Gihon are still completely unknown.
Genesis gives us more clues.
It says the Pishon flowed around a land called Havilah, which was known for its gold, and the Gihon flowed around Cush.
Now, the problem is that no one knows exactly where the ancient lands of Havilah and Cush were.
Different people have different ideas, but till today, the location has never been found.
Some people believe Eden was a special place that cannot be found on any modern map.
Who are the four angels bound in the Euphrates River?
Revelation nine talks about four angels who are imprisoned at the Euphrates River.
The Bible does not give their names, explain what they did, or tell us how long they have been there.
It only says they are waiting for one exact hour, day, month, and year.
When that moment comes, they will be released to kill one third of humanity.
With today's population, that would be almost 2.8 billion people.
Even after seeing all this destruction, the people who survive still will not choose to repent.
Revelation says they will continue to worship idols, commit murder, practice sorcery, commit sexual sins, and steal.
In recent years, videos have spread online claiming that strange sounds were heard near the Euphrates as parts of the river dried up.
Some people said they could hear screams and the sound of heavy chains coming from below.
Many people believe these were the four angels, but none of these recordings has been proven to be real.
But how did these angels get there?
The Bible does not tell us exactly.
Many believe they were once angels in heaven who rebelled against God.

transcript.text: The Church of the Holy Sepulchre remains the most likely location, but there are still no evidence that can prove it was Jesus exact tomb.
What happened to Noah's Ark?
After the flood, the Bible says Noah's ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
But after Noah, his family, and the animals came out of the ark, the Bible never mentions the ark again.
The Bible says mountains of Ararat, not Mount Ararat.
Ararat was the name of a large region that covered parts of present day Turkey, Armenia, and Iran.
So when the Bible says the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat, it does not tell us which mountain it was.
It could have been any mountain in that area.
Some people believe Noah took the ark apart and used the wood to build homes.
Others believe the ark slowly rotted away over the years, or that it became buried under snow and ice.
For centuries, people have searched Mount Ararat and claimed to find pieces of wood that they believed came from the ark.
But none of these pieces have ever been proven to be from Noah's ark.
Then, in 1959, people noticed a large shape near Mount Ararat that looked like a boat.
This place became known as the Durupinar site.
Some people believe this boat-shaped formation could be the remains of Noah's ark.
But many geologists disagree.
They believe the shape was made naturally by rocks and is not Noah's ark.
So, was the ark taken apart and used for something else?
Did it slowly disappear over time, or is it still hidden somewhere in the mountains of Ararat?
Till today, no confirmed piece of Noah's ark has ever been found.
What happened to the Ark of the Covenant?
The Ark of the Covenant was a wooden chest covered in gold.
God gave Moses specific instructions for how it should be made.
Inside the ark were the stone tablets containing the Ten Commandments.
Moses had first broken the original tablets after he came down from the mountain and saw the Israelites worshipping a golden calf.
God later gave him new tablets, and these were placed inside the ark.
The ark was kept in the most sacred room of Solomon's temple.
For the Israelites, the ark represented God's presence among them.
The ark was not an ordinary chest.
The Bible describes powerful and frightening things happening around it.
When priests carrying the ark stepped into the Jordan River, the water stopped flowing, allowing the Israelites to cross.
The Israelites also carried the ark around Jericho, and the city's walls fell.
When the Philistines captured the ark, sickness spread through the cities where they took it.
Later, a man named Uzza touched the ark, and he immediately died.
The last clear mention of the ark is during the time of King Josiah.
A few years later, the Babylonians attacked Jerusalem and destroyed Solomon's temple.
The Bible lists many of the treasures the Babylonians took from the temple, but the ark is not mentioned.
After that, the Bible never tells us what happened to it.
So what really happened to the ark?
Some believe the Babylonians destroyed it.
Others believe the priests hid it somewhere beneath the temple before the Babylonians attacked.
But searching beneath the temple mount is almost impossible because the area is sacred to several religions and is also politically sensitive.
There is also an ancient story that says the prophet Jeremiah hid the ark inside a cave on Mount Nebo and sealed the entrance.
Another claim comes from the Ethiopian Orthodox Church.
The church believes the ark is kept inside a small chapel in Axum, Ethiopia.
According to the tradition, only one chosen guardian is allowed to enter the chapel and see the ark.
Even the church's leaders are not allowed to inspect it.
Till today, no one knows what happened to the ark or where it is.
I'm Owen's Bible.
If this message resonated with you, hit the subscribe button.
See you in the next video.
